Midday Prayer (Sext)

Wednesday of week 27 in Ordinary Time

Year: B(II). Psalm week: 3. Liturgical Colour: Green.

INTRODUCTION
O God, come to our aid.
℟. O Lord, make haste to help us.
Glory be to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Alleluia.
HYMN

The hymn may be taken from the appendix.

O God of truth, O Lord of might,
who orderest time and change aright,
and send'st the early morning ray,
and light'st the glow of perfect day.
PSALMODY

Psalms of the day

Complementary psalms

PSALMS OF THE DAY

Psalm 118(119):105-112XIV (Nun)

A lamp for my steps

Ant. DAYPSALM-A Your word is a lamp for my steps.
Your word is a lamp for my steps
and a light for my path.
I have sworn and have determined
to obey your decrees.
Ant. DAYPSALM-A Your word is a lamp for my steps.
Psalm 70 (71)I
Ant. DAYPSALM-B Be a rock of refuge for me.
In you, O Lord, I take refuge;
let me never be put to shame.
In your justice rescue me, free me:
pay heed to me and save me.
Ant. DAYPSALM-B Be a rock of refuge for me.
Psalm 70 (71)II
Ant. DAYPSALM-C Listen to my prayer, O Lord.
My lips will tell of your justice
and day by day of your help.
O God, you have taught me from my youth
and I proclaim your wonders still.
Ant. DAYPSALM-C Listen to my prayer, O Lord.

COMPLEMENTARY PSALMS

Psalm 122 (123)
Ant. COMPPSALM-A To you have I lifted up my eyes.
To you have I lifted up my eyes,
you who dwell in the heavens:
my eyes, like the eyes of slaves
on the hand of their lords.
Ant. COMPPSALM-A To you have I lifted up my eyes.
Psalm 123 (124)
Ant. COMPPSALM-B Our help is in the name of the Lord.
"If the Lord had not been on our side,"
this is Israel's song.
Ant. COMPPSALM-B Our help is in the name of the Lord.
Psalm 124 (125)
Ant. COMPPSALM-C Those who put their trust in the Lord.
Those who put their trust in the Lord
are like Mount Zion, that cannot be shaken.
Ant. COMPPSALM-C Those who put their trust in the Lord.

CONCLUSION

SHORT READINGJeremiah 17:7-8
A blessing on the man who puts his trust in the Lord, with the Lord for his hope.
℣. Lord, you have searched me and you know me.
℟. You know my resting and my rising.
CONCLUDING PRAYER
Let us pray.
Lord God, you reveal your power in mercy: grant us your grace. Through Christ our Lord.
Amen.
Let us praise the Lord.
– Thanks be to God.
